prospective.outcome_time_convention: SPC daily files are convective days (12 UTC to 12 UTC); HHMM is UTC; rows before 1200 are placed on the next UTC date
prospective.skill_reference: bss_vs_causal_climatology: reference = base rate of the SAME model version's storm-forecasts whose 24 h window matured before the forecast was issued (no outcome leak; versions differ in event definition). bss_vs_sample_climatology: reference = pooled base rate of the scored set itself (in-sample, shown for comparison). Both are null when no event was observed. Scored on the model's full-precision probability.

exact_model_benchmark.label: Pre-registered programme (docs/TORNADO_MODEL_PROGRAM.md): every choice made on 2023, development test 2024, scored once on every 2025 storm observation (1,469,977; 1,579 tornadic).

related_benchmark.label: A historical 2024 holdout benchmark exists for a related tornado GBT family, but not yet as an exact score for the live storm-object model. Its Brier/BSS were measured at a downsampled base rate of 0.003 and are not comparable to live skill at the natural base rate.

hazards.recommended_action: Judge the live tornado model on the pooled BSS against causal climatology (and its served-probability split), not on per-forecast means or the downsampled research holdout.
